g.text: TriageGraph: feature modules and the shared ports between them
Hollow-triangle arrow: the module provides (implements) the port. Open arrow: the module uses it.
IncidentQueryPort is also read by triage, assignment, sla, topology and notification;
CatalogQuery and UserDirectory are used by most modules (edges omitted for clarity).
Domain events flow through DomainEventPublisher: audit and SLA priority listeners run
